name: Replicate
summary: Run almost any community model through one API, billed per second of compute instead of per token.
description:
Replicate's catalogue is the point: thousands of models from the long tail of research releases — image, video, audio, 3D, text — each wrapped in a versioned model you can call with a JSON body, with no deployment work at all. For exploring whether a niche checkpoint solves your problem it is the fastest possible test, and the per-second billing suits spiky workloads.

Cold starts are the tax on that flexibility, and they are visible to your users. Model quality in the community catalogue varies enormously, licensing is per-model and often overlooked, and anything you build on a specific version should be pinned because researchers retire checkpoints without warning.
